column1: # java-declaration: one selected Java declaration emits one CLR row.

# java-synthetic-member: Java enum values/valueOf expansion emits a CLR row.
# java-closeable-disposable: a public Java Closeable type emits its required IDisposable.Dispose member.
# java-functional-adapter-type/member: a public Java functional interface emits its reusable CLR delegate adapter.
# java-compatibility-type/member: reusable Java compatibility shape is public because a selected public signature or base type requires it.
# clr-special-accessor: CLR property/event metadata expands one compatibility declaration into its externally accessible special method.
